_about: Optional CPU benchmark table. Intentionally EMPTY: no numbers are shipped because none were verified. Add entries from one consistent source (e.g. your own Geekbench 6 or Cinebench R23 lookups). Keys are normalised model names: "i5-8350u", "ryzen 7 5800h", "ultra 7 155h", "apple m1". Scores map through score = 100*x/(x+reference): a CPU equal to the reference scores 50.
